newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain recalls Iran ambassador after German verdict.
newsitem.headline: Spain recalls Iran ambassador after German verdict.

text.p: Spain recalled its ambassador to Iran on Friday in response to a European Union appeal after a German court accused Iranian political leaders of ordering the murder of four Kurdish dissidents in Berlin.

"...The Spanish government has recalled the Spanish ambassador in Tehran for joint consultations with its European partners, with the aim of re-evaluating European Union relations with Iran," a foreign ministry statement said.
Spain said it was taking the decision in accordance with the proposal of the Presidency of the European Union on Thursday and in solidarity with Germany.
The EU action followed a German court finding on Thursday that senior state leaders of Iran ordered the killings of a group of Iranian Kurdish leaders in a Berlin restaurant in 1992.

The 15 EU member states, supporting Germany, decided to recall their envoys and said they saw no room to continue their so-called "critical dialogue" while Iran "flouts international norms and indulges in acts of terrorism".
